chunks: Like (those) We had sent to those schismatics who slandered their Books

key_terms.الْمُقْتَسِمِينَ: The schismatics or those who divided (the Quran)

ai.seo_question: Who are the Al-Muqtasim mentioned in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'Al-Muqtasim' refers to those who divided the Quran into distinct, independent parts, often associated with the Qaraites or early sects that emphasized abrogation (naskh) to the extent of fragmenting the text's unity. This verse critiques their approach by highlighting how their division led to a loss of the Quran's cohesive divine message, contrasting with the Shia view of the Quran as a unified whole where abrogation clarifies rather than fragments revelation.
